name: OpenClaw runtime
summary: OpenClaw is an open-source personal AI assistant that runs on your own machine. A local Gateway daemon is the control plane for sessions, tools, events and channel connections, and each turn runs in-process through an embedded agent loop. Models and alternative harnesses such as Codex plug in, and the assistant is reached through 20+ chat apps and native apps.
facts: WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Signal, iMessage and more
Turns serialized per session through the Gateway
Tools run on the host for the main session unless sandboxing is configured
Free; no paid tier or hosted service
goodFor: Always-on personal assistant on your own hardware
Reaching one agent from many chat apps
Swapping models and harnesses as plugins
watchOut: Host tool access by default; read the security guide first
Fast release cadence, including beta channels
